requirements.requirement: Reject missing, future, circular, and non-evidence dependencies; preserve exact premise ancestry.
requirements.minimal_builder_change: No core change. Retain EvidenceGraph validation and ordered premise resolution.

requirements.requirement: Preserve lexical assumption locality and prevent local facts from escaping without discharge.
requirements.minimal_builder_change: No core change for lexical scope; preserve ScopeStmt and RefinementEnv frame behavior.

requirements.requirement: Map neutral state, action, dependencies, scopes, and exact deltas into HML-owned objects without dropping provenance.
requirements.minimal_builder_change: Add a versioned neutral-transition import adapter; do not add syntax.

requirements.requirement: Apply one fail-closed precondition contract to every partial operation, including unsupported/unknown outcomes.
requirements.minimal_builder_change: Extend the existing term-level contract registry and side-condition dispatch; unknown contracts must block.

requirements.requirement: Preserve obligation identity, origin, dependencies, scope, persistence, and named discharge across neutral imports and renderings.
requirements.minimal_builder_change: Expose existing ReasoningObligation records through the neutral adapter and round-trip them losslessly.

requirements.requirement: Represent candidates separately from facts with PROPOSED, UNVERIFIED, VERIFIED, and REJECTED lifecycle states.
requirements.minimal_builder_change: Add one first-class candidate state object and verifier-owned lifecycle; do not add domain-specific candidate keywords.

requirements.requirement: Promote a candidate only after independent evidence checks every recorded original constraint in the same scope.
requirements.minimal_builder_change: Add a generic candidate-check verdict consuming candidate id, constraint ids, context hash, and trusted evidence.

requirements.requirement: Join branch-local conclusions only when required branches are closed and exhaustive/disjoint coverage is certified.
requirements.minimal_builder_change: Add a generic case-partition/branch-result/join proof protocol reusing lexical frames and evidence envelopes.

requirements.requirement: Bind warrant identity, exact premise list, target claim, checker version, and context hash in a replay-resistant evidence envelope.
requirements.minimal_builder_change: Define a narrow trusted adapter API over CertificateEnvelope; source must never register its own trusted checker.

requirements.requirement: Supply theorem and domain warrants through replayable library evidence rather than new core operations.
requirements.minimal_builder_change: Add only the minimal generic library registration/evidence path needed by approved fixtures; defer broad theorem ingestion.

requirements.requirement: Keep PROPOSED/CHECKED/VERIFIED/REJECTED outcomes checker-owned and block VERIFIED under unresolved mandatory debt.
requirements.minimal_builder_change: No semantic change; extend the same ownership rule to candidates and branch joins.

requirements.requirement: Discharge a goal only from a VERIFIED derivation of the canonically identical target.
requirements.minimal_builder_change: No core change. Preserve ProvedStmt adjudication and canonical target identity checks.

requirements.requirement: Reject type/domain mismatches and return unresolved rather than guessing when domain evidence is unavailable.
requirements.minimal_builder_change: Extend declared-type propagation into certificate and adapter contexts; preserve fail-closed unknown types.

requirements.requirement: Provide domain-specific applicability facts through libraries, not kernel keywords.
requirements.minimal_builder_change: Add typed, versioned domain checker entries only as demanded by accepted fixtures and independent evidence.

requirements.requirement: Render every accepted neutral semantic field without hiding adapter state or claiming unsupported pure-HML equivalence.
requirements.minimal_builder_change: After R03/R06/R08, add a lossless versioned renderer and reject unsupported fields instead of commenting them away.
